units.source_text: 父亲严肃的盯着跑到店外看人力车的我。

en.t: My father stared sternly at me as I ran outside the shop to look at the rickshaws.

units.source_text: 现在的孩子坐人力车估计没什么可开心的了。

en.t: Children today probably would not find much to be happy about in riding a rickshaw.

units.source_text: 不过当时的我们对坐人力车就像坐汽车一样兴奋不已。

en.t: But in those days we were as thrilled to ride in a rickshaw as if we were riding in an automobile.

units.source_text: 但是，目前正在病中，刚才有发生了那样激烈的争吵，我实在说不出自己很想去的话。

en.t: But I was ill just then, and after such a fierce quarrel had just taken place, I simply could not bring myself to say that I really wanted to go.

units.source_text: 我依旧一副泄了气的样子，低声说：“想去。”

en.t: Still looking deflated, I said in a low voice, "I want to go."
